title: Maximum sum with no two neighbours
summary: Carol singers collect donations along a street but never sing at two neighbouring houses; decide at each house whether to stop.
goal: Collect the most donations without visiting two neighbouring houses

mapping.story: Best total up to house i

ladder.name: Try every allowed route
ladder.idea: List every set of houses with no two neighbours and add up each one.

ladder.name: Best total up to each house
ladder.idea: Write, for each house, the best total using houses up to it: skip it (best up to the previous house) or sing here (this donation plus best up to two houses back).
ladder.insight: At each house there are only two choices, and each leaves a smaller street of the same kind. Writing down the best total for every prefix avoids recomputing it.

ladder.name: Keep only two totals
ladder.idea: Each house's best only uses the bests one and two houses back, so roll two numbers forward.
ladder.insight: Older entries of the table are never read again, so two variables are enough.

transfer.problem: A delivery driver can take a job on any day but needs a rest day after each job. Maximise the total pay from a list of daily job offers.
transfer.explanation: No two consecutive days: best up to day i is the better of skipping day i or taking it plus the best up to day i − 2.

selfCheck: Compares skipping a house with singing there.
Uses the best from two houses back when singing.
Uses O(1) extra space in the final version.
